```{r load data from PG, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

 #drv <- RPostgres::dbDriver("PostgreSQL") 
con <-  RPostgres::dbConnect(drv = Postgres(), user = "postgres", 
                             password = Sys.getenv("db_password"), 
                             dbname = Sys.getenv("dbname"), port = "5433") 

utopia_bl <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT DISTINCT
                      block_id
                    FROM raw_fcc.bdc_avail_d25_ut
                    WHERE provider_id = '230051';")

cnty_fips = str_sub(utopia_bl$block_id, 3, 5) %>% unique()

ut_bl <- blocks(state = "UT",county = cnty_fips, year = 2024)

utopia_geo <- ut_bl %>% inner_join(y = utopia_bl, by = c("GEOID20" = "block_id") ) %>% st_transform(4326)

ut_counties <- counties(state = "UT", cb=FALSE, year = 2024)

```

```{r map utopia}

#95A300



map_utopia <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = ut_counties, fill = "#284049", color = "white", linewidth = 0.05, alpha = .9) +
  geom_sf(data = utopia_geo, fill = "#95A300", color = NA)  +
  labs(
    title    = "UTOPIA",
    subtitle = "Utah Telecommunication\nOpen Infrastructure Agency",
    caption  = "Data: FCC Broadband Data Collection (as of Dec 2025)"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8FAFC", color = NA),
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 42, 
                                   face = "bold", 
                                   hjust = 0.5,
                                   color = "#95A300",
                                   margin = margin(b = 7)),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 38, 
                                   face = "bold", 
                                   color = "#111827",
                                   margin = margin(b = 1),
                                   hjust = 0.5,
                                   lineheight = .5),
    plot.caption    = element_text(size = 18, 
                                   color = "#9CA3AF",
                                   margin = margin(t = 5),
                                   hjust = .25),
    plot.title.position   = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    plot.margin = margin(20, 50, 20, 50)
  )

map_utopia

```

```{r save and export image}


ggsave("utopia_d25.png", map_utopia,  dpi = 150, bg = "#F8FAFC", device = ragg::agg_png)
```
